title: Head of Finance
description:
About DEUNA 🧡

DEUNA is a rapidly growing startup revolutionizing global commerce with ATHIA, our AI-powered orchestration and payments platform that helps large enterprises boost approval rates, reduce costs, and unlock new revenue. Built by the team behind DEUNA -the fastest-growing Commerce OS in Latin America-ATHIA combines payment intelligence, checkout optimization, and data orchestration in one powerful solution.
With deep integrations across 300+ PSPs and alternative payment methods, and over 20% of Mexico’s digital economy running through our platform, we simplify global payments through a single integration and centralized reconciliation.
We are a rapidly growing startup expanding into the U.S. to meet the urgent needs of large retailers, marketplaces, airlines, and QSRs. Join us to shape the future of payments! 🚀
Visit to learn more about us!
As the Head of Finance , you will be responsible for overseeing all financial aspects of the company, including financial planning, analysis, forecasting, reporting and accounting. You will play a key role in driving the financial strategy, ensuring sustainable growth, and helping to scale our operations. You will collaborate with the leadership team to align financial goals with business objectives, manage cash flow, and ensure financial stability as we continue to innovate in the payments industry.
Key Responsibilities:

Financial Strategy & Planning :
Develop and execute financial strategies to support the company’s overall objectives and growth targets.
Lead financial forecasting, budgeting, and long-term financial planning processes.
Provide insights and recommendations to the executive team based on financial data to drive business decisions.

Financial Reporting & Compliance: Oversee the preparation and presentation of financial statements, reports, and analysis to the executive team and investors.
Ensure compliance with local and international financial regulations, including tax, accounting standards (e.g., IFRS), and regulatory bodies relevant to the payments industry.
Maintain internal controls and processes to ensure accuracy and integrity in all financial reporting.

Cash Flow & Capital Management :
Manage and optimize cash flow, working capital, and liquidity to ensure smooth operations and sustainable growth.
Develop strategies to mitigate financial risks and ensure financial stability during periods of rapid growth.

Financial Analysis & Business Intelligence :
Lead financial modeling and analysis to identify key business metrics, growth opportunities, and risks.
Track KPIs related to the financial performance of the company and its products, including revenue, margins, and customer acquisition costs.
Provide actionable insights on financial performance, cost structures, and profitability to guide strategic decision-making.

Investor Relations & Reporting :
Manage relationships with investors, ensuring clear and transparent communication regarding the company’s financial performance.
Prepare and present regular updates on financial performance.

Leadership & Team Management :
Lead and build a high-performing finance team, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Mentor and develop team members, helping them grow professionally and enhancing their skills.
Improve current tools and processes to increase efficiency and accuracy in financial operations.

Collaboration Across Departments :
Work closely with the product, operations, marketing, and sales teams to provide financial insights and guidance to optimize business strategies.
Ensure alignment between finance and other departments, supporting data-driven decision-making across the organization.
Previous Relevant Experience

• 10+ years of experience in finance, with at least 4 years in a senior leadership role (preferably in the fintech or payments industry).

• Strong experience in financial planning and analysis (FP&A), financial reporting, and regulatory compliance.

title: Product Marketing Director
description:

At ServiceTrade , you’ll build technology that matters - for your career, your team, and the thousands of commercial contractors who rely on our platform every day. We’re on a mission to partner with commercial trades to deliver technology that enhances technician productivity, improves customer experiences, and drives scalable growth.
We’re looking for a Product Marketing Director who’s excited to make an impact. This is a high-impact, highly visible leadership role on a team operating in a rapidly transforming industry - where technology, data, and AI are reshaping how essential service work gets done.
You will own how our products are positioned, brought to market, adopted, and expanded across thousands of technicians, service managers, and business leaders who run their operations on ServiceTrade . You’ll build and lead the product marketing function, translating customer insight, market dynamics, and product innovation into sharp messaging and winning go-to-market strategy - then rally the company around it.
This role carries particular responsibility for how we launch new products, especially AI-powered capabilities. You’ll set the standard for how ServiceTrade tells the story of what AI means for our customers - building trust, articulating tangible value, and driving adoption rather than skepticism.
Why ServiceTrade :
You’ll belong here from the start.
We bring together kind, curious people with diverse perspectives and trust them with meaningful work. You’ll have ownership, clarity, and support to solve real problems, make a visible impact for our customers, and continue growing as your role evolves.

You are comfortable operating at the executive level - presenting to the CEO, CPO, and board - while also being hands-on enough to sharpen a sentence, tighten a deck, or rewrite a launch brief yourself when it matters. • Personally shape the narrative for major launches and strategic initiatives - writing (or directly editing) the messaging, launch briefs, and content that matter most.

• Build and maintain a rigorous competitive intelligence program, translating market and competitor shifts into positioning guidance, battlecards, and sales

title: Paid Search Strategist, DTC eCommerce
description:
Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.
That is the whole job.
Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.
So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.
At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.
Google is where we are putting our next round of growth. You would own a set of those accounts end to end.
Here is what "end to end" actually means.
You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.
You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.
You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.
You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact and there is nobody else to cover it. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.
If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.
If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.
Requirements
What the job looks like

•
Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.

•
Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.

•
Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.

•
Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.

•
Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.

•
Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created

title: Researcher, Agent Safety, Training and Evaluations
description:
About the Team

The Agent Safety team works to ensure that increasingly capable AI agents act safely, exercise sound judgment, and remain aligned with user intent. Our mission is to reduce the probability of severe unintended outcomes from increasingly capable AI agents while preserving their ability to act effectively and autonomously.

Our work spans three areas:

- Training: Create training methods, environments and data that teach agents to make better decisions in consequential situations. We turn real-world failures into training signals that prevent similar incidents, and identify precursor behaviors and mitigations to address emerging risks.

- Measurements: Build evaluations and production metrics that identify emerging risks and measure whether our interventions work.

- Oversight: Develop oversight and system mitigation mechanisms that reduce harmful actions while preserving useful autonomy (for example future versions of https://alignment.openai.com/auto-review/).

About the Role
We’re looking for strong executors with excellent judgment, comfort with ambiguity, and an understanding of frontier model research. You don’t need prior safety or alignment experience, we also welcome people that recently realized that alignment and safety is a critical area to contribute to.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

- Train and evaluate frontier models to reduce harmful or misaligned agent actions, forming clear hypotheses and executing independently through ambiguity.

- Mine incidents and build scalable measurement, data-processing, and evaluation systems that turn real failures into repeatable safety signals.

- Collaborate closely with post-training, capabilities, oversight, and pre-training partners to ship research-backed mitigations into large-scale training and agent systems.

You might thrive in this role if you:

- Have demonstrated strength in research engineering, ML engineering, quantitative research, or applied model research, with the ability to own ambiguous projects end to end.

- Bring excellent technical execution across experimentation, data, evaluation, and/or infrastructure, plus strong intuition for modern frontier-model research.

- Are motivated by agent safety and eager to work on urgent, practical problems even if your prior work was outside safety or alignment.

Lead meaningful risk transformation at the heart of financial services

Capco is seeking Financial Risk Consultants and Senior Consultants to join our growing Finance, Risk, Regulatory & Financial Crime (FRRF) capability. You'll advise clients on regulatory frameworks, optimise risk controls, and lead transformation in support of Chief Risk Officers. This is a chance to deliver complex, high-impact work across credit, market, liquidity, and capital risks. • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with experience using approved AI tools to support analysis, productivity, and decision-making.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills together with an interest in responsible AI adoption within regulated environments.

Bonus Points For

• Experience presenting to senior stakeholders and influencing across business functions.

• Experience delivering data, analytics, technology, or AI-enabled risk transformation initiatives.

• Contributions to risk frameworks, control evaluation, or target operating model design.

• Access continuous learning, industry certifications, and structured career development.

• Help shape the future of risk transformation through innovation, automation, and technology.

title: SAP HCM Consultant - PA/OM/PY
description:
This is a remote position.
For a Polish SAP consulting project, we are looking for an experienced SAP HCM Consultant with strong expertise in Personnel Administration (PA), Organizational Management (OM) and Payroll (PY), particularly around HR data migration. This is a hands-on consulting opportunity where you will work directly with the client's HR/Payroll team to analyse source data, clarify migration requirements and support the successful transfer and validation of employee data into SAP HCM. You will work closely with the client's HR department, translating business and payroll requirements into clear migration rules and ensuring that the data transferred into SAP is complete, consistent and ready for testing and further processing. If you have strong knowledge of Polish payroll and HR processes and have previously worked on SAP HCM data migration projects, this could be a very good fit.
Scope of responsibilities:

• Analyse the provided HR data migration templates and clarify the meaning and purpose of individual fields with the client where required.

• Work directly with the client's HR/Payroll department to complete, validate and clarify source data.

• Define the required scope of migration, including the distinction between data valid as of the migration date and the full history of employment and payroll data.

• Assess how the agreed migration scope impacts the complexity and timeline of the migration.

• Identify and define cumulative payroll values that need to be migrated, including ZUS contribution bases and sickness benefit bases from the previous 12 months.

• Translate Polish HR and payroll requirements into appropriate SAP HCM migration requirements and solutions.

• Support migration testing and verify the correctness and completeness of migrated employee data.

• Investigate data inconsistencies and work with the client to resolve issues identified during migration and testing.

• Provide hands-on SAP HCM expertise and support the client throughout the migration process.

Requirements

MUST HAVE:

• Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience with SAP HCM, particularly PA/OM/PY.

• Very good knowledge of Polish HR and payroll processes, including employment regulations, ZUS contributions and personal income tax.

• Proven experience participating in HR data migration projects into SAP HCM.

• Practical understanding of SAP HCM employee and payroll data structures and migration requirements.

• Ability to analyse source HR/payroll data and identify missing, inconsistent or incorrect information.

• Ability to explain technical SAP and migration topics in clear, business-friendly language to non-technical stakeholders, particularly the client's HR/Payroll department.

• Comfortable working directly with the client and taking ownership of assigned migration activities.

NICE TO HAVE:

• Previous experience migrating HR/payroll data from enova365 or similar HR and payroll systems.

• Experience with additional SAP HCM functionality, particularly Time Management.

• Experience working with historical payroll data and cumulative values required for payroll processing.

• Previous experience working directly with Polish HR/Payroll departments during SAP implementations or migrations.

If this profile matches your experience and you are interested in working on an SAP HCM migration project, get in touch and we can have a quick, informal call to discuss the details.

Senior Meeting & Event Manager

ABOUT EXPERIENCE BY INDUSTRIOUS

Experience by Industrious is a workplace hospitality brand launched by CBRE - built on the idea that where you work should actually feel like somewhere worth showing up to. We combine CBRE's real estate scale with Industrious' operating model to run dedicated experience teams across office assets, enterprise headquarters, healthcare facilities, and logistics centers worldwide.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Meeting and event space is either a real revenue driver or an underused amenity. You're the reason it becomes the former.

As a Senior Meeting & Event Manager, you own the commercial performance of a building's bookable spaces - from initial inquiry through post-event follow-up. You manage inbound bookings, build outbound sales strategy, develop the local marketing approach, and set the service standards that make clients want to come back.

This is a sales role with a hospitality soul. You're not just coordinating logistics - you're actively growing a business within a building. That means tracking pipeline, converting leads, building relationships with recurring clients, and finding new ones.

The best people in this role understand that every event is a chance to demonstrate what this building is capable of - and they take that personally.

WINNING IN THIS ROLE MEANS

• Meeting and event revenue meets or exceeds quarterly targets, and you have a clear pipeline story for why.

• Clients rebook. They refer others. They tell their colleagues this is the space to use in this market.

• Every booking runs smoothly from first contact to final invoice - and the client notices.

• The building's meeting and event reputation is strong enough that inbound inquiries are growing.

• Your Tripleseat data is clean, current, and actually tells a story about what's working.

YOU'LL LOVE THIS ROLE AND SUCCEED AT IT IF

• You're comfortable being both the salesperson and the operator. You close the booking and then make sure it runs well. Neither half feels like a distraction from the other.

• You enjoy the commercial side of hospitality. Conversion rates, average booking value, outbound strategy - these aren't just numbers to you. They're how you know whether you're doing your job well.

• You take follow-through seriously. A client emails at 8pm the night before their event. You respond. Not because you have to, but because you understand what's at stake for them.

• You build relationships, not just transactions. You remember what a client needed last time. You reach out when a new space opens up. You think about their business, not just their booking.

• You're organized under pressure. Three events on the same day, a vendor running late, and a new inquiry in your inbox. You handle all of it without anything slipping.

• You have a feel for what makes a great event space. Room setup, lighting, catering presentation, AV - you notice when something's slightly off, and you fix it before the client does.

NOT THE RIGHT FIT IF

• You prefer to focus on operations and leave the sales side to someone else. Here, both are your job.

• You find outbound sales activity (prospecting, follow-up, pipeline management) draining rather than energizing.

• You're not comfortable managing multiple events simultaneously across a shared calendar.

• You'd rather hand off a client once the booking is confirmed. Here, you stay with them through the event itself.

• You see the event space as just another amenity. Here, it's a revenue line you're accountable for.

WHAT YOU OWN

General management:

• Submit financial and engagement reporting on time and to standard, including the annual business plan and quarterly asset management recaps.

• Monitor trends on a regular cadence so internal teams and asset managers can understand the business and adjust when needed.

• Manage amenity budgets.

• Build clear systems and procedures that set the team up for success when you're not there.

• Execute on stakeholder engagement plans to gather data, develop and share medical insights that contribute to enhancement of Sanofi ’s key medical messages, plans and future research.

Our deep understanding of the immune system - and innovative pipeline - enables us to invent medicines and vaccines thattreat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people's lives.

title: Principal Mining Engineer (Australian Mining Experience)
description:

Role: Principal Mining Engineer
Compensation: Competitive Basic Salary
Benefits: HMO plus 2 free dependents and PHP 1,500 rice allowance
Work Schedule: 5-day work week, 7:00 a.m. 4:00 p.m. Philippine time
Work Setup: WFH or WFO
Job Summary:
The Principal Mining Engineer (Remote International) is responsible for delivering high-quality mine planning, design, and scheduling services to our client's clients from a fully remote location outside Australia.
The position holder applies senior technical expertise to lead and undertake mine planning studies, resolve complex operational problems, and provide independent technical advice across a range of commodities and operations.
The role is structured as a full-time employee and requires a high degree of self-direction, reliable availability during agreed working hours, and the ability to collaborate effectively across geographic and time zone boundaries.
All work is delivered digitally; occasional travel to Australia or client sites may be required for specific project engagements.
Job Duties and Responsibilities:

• Deliver mine designs, schedules, and life-of-mine plans that meet client requirements for technical rigor, accuracy, and timeliness, working fully remotely.

• Lead and conduct mine planning studies, strategic evaluations, and technical reviews across client operations.

• Apply production forecasting and scenario analysis to support informed client decision-making.

• Identify and assess opportunities to improve mine productivity, performance, and economic value.

• Provide practical, well-reasoned solutions to complex mine planning and operational challenges.

• Present technical findings, study outcomes, and recommendations clearly and confidently to clients and their senior stakeholders via remote communication channels.

• Manage client relationships professionally and independently within the remote context, maintaining responsiveness and clear communication across time zones.

• Provide mentoring and technical guidance to junior engineers within the client's organization as required, using remote collaboration tools.

• Support our client's project delivery across multiple clients and commodity types.

• Maintain thorough digital records and documentation in accordance with the company's standards, ensuring accessibility for the broader team.

• Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of internal technical standards and practices.

Job Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Mining Engineering or a closely related field.

• Significant mine planning and scheduling experience in the hard rock mining industry.

• Experience with Australian mining operations or standards .

• Senior-level experience, ideally at Senior or Principal Engineer level or equivalent.

• Strong proficiency in Deswik or similar mine scheduling software.

• Proven experience in mine design, life-of-mine planning, and production scheduling .

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

• Ability to work independently and manage deliverables remotely without on-site supervision.

• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills .

• Experience in client management and technical consulting , preferably in a remote environment.

• Reliable WFH setup , including stable internet and capability for video conferencing and digital collaboration.

• Strong commitment to workplace safety and professional standards .

Preferred / Nice-to-Have

• Direct experience in the Australian mining industry .

• Experience with multiple commodities or mining methods .

• Experience in both open-cut and underground mining .

• Knowledge of Surpac, Vulcan, Datamine , or other mine planning software.

• International consulting or remote advisory experience.

• Familiarity with Australian mining regulations and standards .

•
AusIMM membership or equivalent professional membership.

title: Cloud Cost Governance Lead - Multi-Cloud FinOps
description:
This is a remote position.

Location: Remote across India; may transition to onsite in the future Work Timings: EMEA/US; owns 24x7 escalation coverage

The Role

Own end-to-end cost visibility, governance, and optimization across our multi-cloud estate, and lead the team that runs it. You will be the single owner entire spend- across every tenant, account, and project. Weighted toward the platforms we use most: Azure (primary), AWS (significant), GCP (working depth)

Responsibilities

•
Cost ownership & chargeback: Own total spends across Azure, AWS, and GCP; maintain a single source of truth; reconcile CSP / Partner Center billing so every line resolves to a client, a programme, or an explicit unallocated bucket that shrinks month over month.

•
Lead the function: Own the 24x7 cost operations pod - shift model, handover discipline, SLAs, coaching - and be the single owner of any cost or billing message that reaches a customer, Microsoft, internal leadership.

•
Monitoring & anomaly detection: Run daily monitoring with threshold alerts per tenant, account, and workload using Azure Cost Management & Partner Center, AWS Cost Explorer / CUR / Budgets, and GCP billing export to BigQuery.

•
Root cause analysis: Own cost incidents end to end - root cause, impact, fix, preventive control, and refund status. .

•
No surprise billing: Own the commercial calendar - NCE terms and cancellation windows, auto-renew posture, GDAP expiries, provider policy changes - plus budgets, thresholds, and tag enforcement, before any of it becomes an invoice.

•
Platform-to-cloud integrity: Ensure provisioning and lifecycle automation reconcile cleanly with actual cloud billing state and define what our internal cost platform builds next.

•
Data & reporting: Own the cost pipelines (Partner Center, AWS CUR, GCP BigQuery export, Power BI / SQL) and publish the monthly leadership one-pager: spend vs budget, variance with cause, unit economics, leaks found vs recovered, forecast, top three actions with owners.

•
Forecasting & optimization: Forecast spend against deployments, subscriptions, and quota headroom; drive commitment-based savings (Azure Reservations, AWS Savings Plans/RIs, GCP CUDs), rightsizing, and budget discipline.

Requirements

Deep knowledge, direct experience, and/or hands-on ownership of:

•
Azure cost management at scale (primary): 5+ years owning Azure FinOps in a multi-tenant / CSP / EA / MCA context - Cost Management, Partner Center, subscription and resource-group billing, reservations, and usage/marketplace attribution.

•
A chargeback or show back model you designed and operated, including how you handled what could not be attributed.

•
AWS cost governance: 2+ years hands-on with Cost Explorer, CUR, Organizations / consolidated billing, Budgets, and Savings Plans / RIs. GCP billing export, budgets, and CUDs: exposure, with appetite to build depth.

•
Cost data & reporting: building (not just consuming) dashboards and pipelines in Power BI / SQL / BigQuery, kept resilient through schema changes. Leading a small shift-based ops team.

•
Strong analytical and communication skills, able to explain cost drivers and trade-offs to technical and business stakeholders, and to write a one-page leadership update that stands on its own.

This is a hands-on ownership role with a team attached. Please apply only if you are actively working with cloud billing and cost data today - we are looking for proven depth in Azure, real competence in AWS, and someone who has owned the number in front of leadership, not familiarity alone

title: Partner Operations Associate
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Wolt creates technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to neighborhoods around the world. In Germany that means thousands of restaurants, from single-site kitchens to national chains, all trying to make the platform work for their business. Partner Operations is the team they come to, and the team that keeps them running well on the platform. We're the people on the other end of the email and the phone - handling the day-to-day requests, answering what's unclear, and nudging partners towards the things that would grow their business with us.

We're a team of five associates and a team lead - looking after restaurant partners across Germany, and we're hiring a sixth associate.

 If you like solving other people's problems properly, and you get a small kick out of leaving someone better off than they were before they got in touch, we'd love to hear from you.

What you’ll be doing

Most of your day is spent in conversation with restaurant partners, by email and on the phone. The bulk of it is the everyday running of an account - a detail to update, a menu change to get right, a payment question that needs a clear answer, a new feature to explain. A smaller but important part is win-back: when a partner is considering leaving Wolt, you're the one who finds out why and works out what would keep them. Either way, what lands with you is yours to see through - sometimes that means solving it yourself, sometimes it means getting it into the hands of the team who can.

Day-to-day in this role you’ll:

• Be the first person our restaurant partners hear back from when they get in touch, working through your ticket queue and seeing each case through - either to an answer or to the team who can give one.

• Handle account, menu, settings and payment queries yourself, and hand a case to the right specialists when it needs them.

• Spot where a partner could be getting more out of Wolt - a promotion, an ads campaign, a stronger menu - and make the case for it.

• Take on the win-back conversations: when a partner is thinking about leaving, understand what's behind it and agree on a way forward that works for them and for us.

• Bring back the patterns you see across your conversations, so we fix the cause rather than answering the same question twice.

• Keep your cases and notes in good order, so anyone on the team can see where a partner stands without having to ask.

Our humble expectations* 

• Experience in a customer support, hospitality, administration or account management role.

• Hands-on experience working a ticket queue in a support or CRM tool - this is the core of the job.

• You're comfortable handling partner conversations by phone and email, including the difficult ones.

• You can work to a documented process while managing a steady flow of requests and deadlines, and use your own judgment on the cases the process doesn't cover.

• You enjoy the commercial side of the conversation - recommending a promotion or an ads campaign, or persuading a partner to stay, is something you'd take on rather than avoid.

• Fluent German (C1 or above) and excellent English.

What we offer

Our team is small enough that your work is visible and big enough that you're never on your own with it. Partner Operations

title: QA Automation Engineer

Responsibilities:

• Maintaining Quality Standards
Continuously monitoring and evaluating products, services, or processes to ensure they meet established quality standards and specifications.

• Issue Identification and Resolution
Identifying defects, errors, or deviations from quality standards, and working with relevant teams to implement corrective actions and prevent recurrence.

• Process Optimization
Developing and implementing improvements to quality assurance processes, testing procedures, and workflows to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.

• Compliance and Documentation
Ensuring compliance with relevant regulations, standards, and internal procedures. Maintaining accurate records of quality checks, audits, and issues.

• Training and Mentorship
Providing training and guidance to other team members on quality assurance processes, standards, and best practices.

• Collaboration and Communication
Collaborating with cross-functional teams (e.g., engineering, manufacturing, operations) to address quality issues and drive continuous improvement.

• Data Analysis and Reporting
Collecting, analyzing, and reporting quality data to identify trends, root causes, and areas for improvement.
Specific Tasks:

• Developing and executing test plans and test cases
Ensuring products or services meet defined quality criteria.

• Conducting audits and assessments
Evaluating adherence to quality standards and identifying areas for improvement.

• Investigate and report bugs with detailed reproduction steps and logs.
Analyzing defects, determining root causes, and implementing corrective actions.

• Monitoring quality metrics
Tracking key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess the effectiveness of quality assurance efforts.

• Participating in design reviews
Providing input on quality considerations during the product development process.

• Staying up-to-date on industry standards and best practices
Continuously learning and adapting to changes in the quality assurance field.

• Maintain and enhance existing automation frameworks

• Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines

• Monitor test results and metrics to identify areas for improvement in test coverage and performance

Required Qualifications
Extensive knowledge of test management software
Working knowledge of C# and .NET technologies
Familiarity with RESTful APIs and tools like Postman for API testing
Experience with version control systems (e.g. Git) and CI/CD tools (CruiseControl.Net & Jenkins)

title: AI Scientist - Entrepreneur in Residence
description:
Molecule and BIO.xyz are building the foundation of Decentralized Science (DeSci) - where biotech meets web3 to make scientific research community-owned, transparent, and faster to market.
Molecule provides the infrastructure to turn intellectual property (IP) into programmable, on-chain assets through our IP-NFT framework and evolving protocol stack. This enables researchers, patients, and communities to fund and govern biotech projects in new, open ways.
is the coordination and economic layer of DeSci, powering BioDAOs through funding, governance, and ecosystem alignment.
Together, we are creating a new model for scientific discovery - one where breakthroughs are owned and advanced by the communities that believe in them.
The Role
You will be an AI Scientist at Molecule. In your first four weeks, you will live on-site, embedded with the founding team, and ship your first autonomous agent fleet into production against a real disease area. From day one you own the loop: design the agents, deploy them, pilot them, iterate, and generate scientific output that moves IP forward.
This is not a research role with a roadmap handed to you. You will pick targets, stand up infrastructure, recruit your sub-agents, and prove that autonomous science works at the bench-to-IP level. After the residency, you scale: more fleets, more disease areas, more shots on goal.
What You'll Do

• Architect and deploy fleets of scientific agents spanning literature mining, target identification, molecular design, assay design, and data analysis

• Pilot each fleet against a specific disease area and drive it to a tangible deliverable - a validated target, a candidate molecule, a novel dataset, an IP-NFT

• Run multiple fleets in parallel across disease areas, reporting results directly to the CEO

• Own the full stack: agent design, orchestration, evaluation, and scientific judgment on outputs

• Define and set the standard for how autonomous science gets done at Molecule

Who You Are

• Entrepreneurial to the core. You ship. You don't wait for permission.

• Technically deep across LLMs, agent frameworks, and at least one wet-science domain - chemistry, biology, pharma, structural biology, or genomics

• Comfortable with ambiguity. You may be the only person in the room who knows how to do what you do, and that energizes you

• Credential-agnostic. PhD, MSc, BSc, or straight from high school - output matters, not titles. If you hold a degree, it should be from a top-tier institution (Oxbridge, Ivy League, MIT, Caltech, Stanford, ETH/EPFL, Imperial, or equivalent). If you skipped the degree, show us what you built instead.

• All-in on intensity. Willing to live on-site for 4 weeks and operate at founder pace

What We Offer

• An early seat at the company building the infrastructure for autonomous science

• Direct ownership over a frontier no one else is running at

• Equity in the form of $BIO token allocation

• The fastest path from idea to deployed IP that exists in biotech today

Join an ever-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams - comprised of the best of the best - work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to constantly raise the bar, you may just be our next NiCEr!

Enjoy NiCE-FLEX!

Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.

• Exceptional written communication skills with experience providing structured critique and editorial guidance.

• Advanced degree in life sciences, pharmacy, or medicine (PhD, PharmD, MD, MSc) or equivalent professional industry experience.

• Broad therapeutic exposure; experience in oncology, neurology, or cardiology is highly desirable.

Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

ABOUT THE ROLE

Relay sells through two core motions. The first is our new-business engine: a B2B enterprise sales motion winning large retailers and brands with significant parcel volumes - and, in time, extending down-market into Small medium enterprises (SME) as that segment opens up. The second is our field engine, which grows Relay's network of "Pitstops" - local shops and businesses that act as pick-up and drop-off points where consumers can collect parcels and return items.

Both motions depend on the systems and processes this role will build and own: the account universe and TAM, lead scoring and prioritisation, outreach, CRM architecture, governance, and sales tooling.

You'll be both architect and operator, and AI-native in how you work. You'll define what great looks like across the systems and processes underpinning both sales motions, then take ownership of making it happen. You’ll also be highly fluent in metrics - using dashboards and funnel data to identify where performance is breaking down, where opportunities are being lost, and where we can drive greater efficiency.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Build the new-business engine: own TAM, account scoring and weekly prioritisation, plus a top-of-funnel (enrichment, multi-threaded contacts, sequencing, signal-based triggers) that lets sales spend their time pitching, not hunting.

- Own the CRM and deal desk: architect Pipedrive around the selling rhythm, govern deal terms, stages and approval gates from pitch to activation, and raise the quality and speed of pitches and proposals.

- Scale the Pitstop engine: run the field team's scoring, territories, targets and dashboards, manage pricing levers and CPA, and keep lead-to-live data clean, pushing toward a self-running engine with algorithmic assignment, referrals and AI-handled inbound.

- Automate relentlessly: own the tooling stack and build-vs-buy calls (defaulting to building), strip manual work out of the sales day, and design systems that extend to SME and self-serve through configuration, not a rebuild.

- Diagnose and fix the funnel: use funnel data to find where deals stall and pipeline leaks, then ship the fixes.

WHO WILL THRIVE IN THIS ROLE

- Systems thinker. You build systems rather than one-off fixes, and you take ideas all the way to a shipped, working solution yourself.

- Proven RevOps experience. You've run sales or revenue operations in a fast-moving environment and know what best-in-class looks like across top-of-funnel, CRM, deal desk and process.

- CRM owner, not just admin. You've implemented and evolved Pipedrive (or similar) so it fits the selling motion, rather than bending the motion to fit the tool.

- Native AI builder. You're fluent with Claude and have shipped real tooling and automations in a live business.

- Fast, practical delivery. You implement quickly and are comfortable scoping work for engineering when you need their help.

- High bar for quali

title: Area Manager (Liboc)
description:

Nehledáme člověka do kanceláře, ale lídra přímo do akce v provozu. Budeš mít přímý vliv na to, jak náš brněnský sklad funguje, jaká v něm bude kultura a jak hladce poběží každodenní logistika.

Proč je tahle role zajímavá

- Dostaneš šanci vést klíčovou část provozu v Liboci a zanechat na fungování skladu svůj přímý otisk.

- Budeš mít reálný dopad na denní provoz, efektivitu směny i spokojenost svého týmu.

- Nečeká tě stereotypní kancelářská práce - budeš přímo v centru dění moderní logistiky.

- Provoz řídíme na základě dat v reálném čase, takže se naučíš pracovat s chytrými nástroji.

- Získáš prostor aktivně měnit a zefektivňovat procesy tam, kde uvidíš příležitost ke zlepšení.

Co tě u nás čeká

- Vedení a motivace týmu na směně, plánování a rozdělování práce i budování týmového ducha.

- Řízení a odpovědnost za klíčové ukazatele (KPIs) s cílem neustále zvyšovat efektivitu směny.

- Práce s daty v reálném čase, sledování čísel a vyhodnocování výkonu provozu.

- Identifikace úzkých hrdel a aktivní navrhování i zavádění procesních vylepšení.

- Úzká kooperace s ostatními odděleními a vedoucími napříč skladem pro zajištění plynulého toku zboží.

- Práce na směny režimu krátký/dlouhý týden (12hodinové směny; 6:00-18:00).

Co od tebe očekáváme

- Prokazatelnou praxi s vedením a motivací lidí v dynamickém prostředí.

- Aktivní angličtinu pro běžnou pracovní komunikaci s kolegy a řešení denních úkolů.

- Uživatelskou znalost práce na PC pro vyhodnocování dat a práci s interními systémy.

- Zodpovědný, spolehlivý a samostatný přístup s chutí rozvíjet se.

- Předchozí zkušenost ze skladového nebo logistického prostředí je výhodou, ne však podmínkou.

Co ti nabízíme

- Fair reward a odpovídající finanční ohodnocení.

- Xtra membership - nakupování na Rohlíku s 10% cashbackem v podobě kreditů na další nákupy.

- Extra time off - čas na regeneraci a odpočinek.

- Good food every day - dotované obědy, dobré jídlo, skvělá káva a čerstvé ovoce přímo na pracovišti.

- Systém odměn za pochvaly - sbírání hvězdiček od kolegů a jejich výměna za vouchery do e-shopů.

- Sport & wellbeing - příspěvek na kartu MultiSport.

- Firemní akce - společné oslavy úspěchů a neformální setkání.

We're fully remote, with developers in Canada and South America and clients across Europe, North America, and South America. We work across healthcare, finance, construction, and manufacturing, and we take the time to understand each client's industry so we can serve it well with technology.

We're big on AI and the cloud. Our services range from app and web development to AI and cloud integration, plus technology consulting: designing feasible, secure, cost-effective architectures for non-technical clients and advising them on their tech stack.

The role

As a React developer you'll work on multiple client projects at once, each with its own tech stack, code, and idiosyncrasies. You'll work with a wide range of code, libraries, and technologies and build the kind of adaptability that comes from switching between projects rather than staying in one repository.

We deliver AI-first. AI generates our tickets and acceptance criteria, we pair with AI while developing, and every pull request goes through AI review before a senior engineer reviews it. That makes us fast. It also means we have no room for developers who can only prompt. You need to be able to read what the AI produced, know when it's wrong, and fix it yourself: solid fundamentals in JavaScript, React's rendering model, semantic HTML, browser performance, and HTTP are the baseline, not a bonus. If you can't explain your code without the tool that wrote it, this isn't the role for you. Part of our technical interview is done without AI assistance.

You'll work directly with clients to architect solutions, discuss new features, and present your progress, most of the time in English. You'll learn to present ideas to clients in a professional, friendly way. Expect to be challenged constantly, and to enjoy the work along the way.

What will help you succeed

• Self-starter who doesn't need micromanagement

• Flexible and goal-oriented

• Enjoys being challenged and learning something new every day

• Strong passion for coding; promotes clean, maintainable code

• Team player, yet autonomous, with a positive spirit

• Picks up new technologies constantly and with ease

• Understands the trade-offs of working as a contractor vs. an employee

We trust you to organize your day, prioritize your week, and keep the team and clients updated as you go.

Requirements

Language

• Fluent Spanish

• Advanced English (able to hold a client conversation without difficulty)

Technical

• 1-2 years of full-time coding experience in React and Next.js

• Strong programming fundamentals: you can design, debug, and explain your code without AI assistance

• Experience with React Native

• Experience with JSON and RESTful services

• Experience with Agile methodologies

Bonus

• Unit and integration testing

• Fluent English (B2+)

• Concise, efficient written and oral communication

What we offer

• Fully remote: work from home or anywhere you choose

• Competitive pay: rates that compete with the best in the Latin American market, tailored to your seniority and skills, paid in the currency you prefer

• Crypto payment available on request

• Full-time contractor: you manage your own finances

As of now, almost everything the user can do in the UI, we have an agent tool for it and the Co-Pilot (daily assistant of the user) can do everything for them, even toggling dark mode on and off.
But the Co-Pilot is just the beginning. The real challenge is the autonomous agents. More on that below.
What you’ll be working on

• Inbox-Agents : Autonomous Agents triggered whenever something new happens inside a ticket. The customer can train them on their own OR rather use one of the templates you will build for them. These agents already have the capabilities to fully own entire complex scenarios and are one of the main reasons customers are interested in our software. But when should the agent escalate to a human rather than finishing on its own? How can we make sure it sticks to the process? Those are your questions.

• Harness Engineering: The agent has 100+ tools. But it has to read a request the way a property manager would, not the way the words sound elsewhere. What goes into the system prompt, what into skills?

• Knowledge base : Our platform includes its own knowledge base, similar to Notion. It’s fully custom built and supposed to act as the companys collective brain. But should the AI also “learn” by itself? And if yes, when? And how can we improve the way our AI searches the knowledge base - through better tools, system prompts, or skills?

• Voice-agents : The same agents, but on the phone - built on LiveKit, handling calls the way our text agents handle tickets.

• LLM Infrastructure. Pick the right model for the job, cache and stream to cut latency, retry when a provider fails, compact context, optimize RAG search, track usage across providers, reduce costs and run evals to see what's actually better.

Our minimalistic tech stack
Everything is TypeScript. From our database schema to the frontend.
Backend: Convex (Database & serverless functions)
Frontend: , React, Tailwind, shadcn/ui
Technologies you will encounter: Vercel AI SDK, Convex Agent Component
Salary

• $2000 - $4000 per month before taxes with room for growth and promotion in the months & years ahead

• Permanent employment contract in your country of residence through our partner Deel (EOR)

Benefits

• 100% remote work

• Allianz Gold Health Insurance with great coverage

• Flexible hours

• As many AI-tokens as you need

• We’re self-funded & profitable (and not burning VC money to survive)

• Small team, real ownership - what you build actually goes live

• Quick decisions, no pointless meetings and no layers of approval to get through

Our special Health Program

• Private room in hospital, worldwide coverage

• Free choice of doctors & specialists, no health check, pre-existing conditions don't matter

• Partner and kids are covered as well

• Surgery, cancer care, MRI/CT/PET scans and diagnostics fully covered

• Dental treatment & surgery covered at 90%

• $675/year for physio, osteopathy, chiropractic and acupuncture

• $100 per night in-patient cash benefit, up to 20 nights

• Prescription drugs, vaccinations, glasses/contacts, home nursing and ambulance covered

Our values

• Get things done, every day matters

• Transparency and honesty, especially when it’s hard

• Strive for greatness - Constantly challenge yourself and others
